_doc: REGISTRATION ONLY. Makes bench's own verify/ entrypoints available as
named checks a run may ask for. It declares NO gates block, so every
gate reads `ungated`: nothing is required and nothing is proved by
registering a check. Inactive until a person copies it to
Each `run` is relative to the check's execution root — the card's
worktree, or the checkout bench pinned for a PR review — so the program
that runs is the one committed in the candidate, never the operator's
installation or the application's main checkout.
work and act-pr keep the legacy grant BOARD_AGENT_COMMANDS gave them
(`python3 -m unittest`) as a named command grant: writing a document
replaces the legacy resolution for an intent it configures, so a
document that dropped it would quietly take the agent's own test runs
